items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] What did John Farris play? What is it?

ctx.x: So, at that time, we were getting $12 apiece. So, I had up to the $15. All right. Harry Budden, I don't, I never would be able to understand this, on up to this day and day. He was a little angry with Harry because of something that had happened with a little band over at Fast Christian had seemed to have fallen apart. And, uh, this little band, the boy that was playing his father was, uh, sort of managing the band. And the other kids in the band figured that they knew too much to have him manage it. So, they…
What did John Farris play? What is it?

Little John played trumpet. He was out in California and I didn't make him recording. So, to fill out the engagement, Harry and myself, we helped out. Now, Harry bought his guitar, he bought his trumpet. And, uh, Chuck became angry because of the fact that he felt that Harry shouldn't have bought his guitar. Well, that Harry's a good fortune if he can play two or three instruments. And, uh, he became angry to Nick's dad. So, when this New Year's job came up, I had called Harry and told him to tell him, Eddie and…
